task: Ground factual claims for Workspace Monitor performance budget close-out.
output_summary: Workspace Monitor now keeps the generated snapshot out of client JavaScript, lazy-loads the monitor UI, and enforces a JavaScript chunk performance budget.

evidence.reliability: Primary implementation for public JSON fetch and dynamic MonitorShell loading.
Primary evidence that generated snapshot is no longer statically imported.
Primary regression check for JavaScript chunk size and static snapshot import.

evidence.source: npm --prefix workspace-monitor run build; npm --prefix workspace-monitor run perf:budget
evidence.reliability: Local build and performance budget output measured largest chunk at 227,537 bytes.
Official React documentation for deferred UI updates.

claims.statement: The generated workspace snapshot is no longer statically imported by lib/snapshot.ts.
The largest built JavaScript chunk is 227,537 bytes after the change.
The previous largest built JavaScript chunk was 6,224,897 bytes before removing the snapshot static import.
verification_steps: Measured workspace-monitor/out/_next/static/chunks before implementation in this turn.

uncertainty_notes: Snapshot JSON itself remains large and should be optimized separately if network transfer becomes the next measured bottleneck.
limitation_notes: This does not add runtime compression or snapshot sharding.
This does not profile every React subtree.
